L1: distinguish timer abort from user supersede/cancel. For EACH nodes/runs/approvals/workspaces catch, a controller.signal.aborted reason OTHER than REQUEST_TIMEOUT must not apply error/stale/success from that cancelled request. Classify timeout from the owned signal reason, not arbitrary err.name==='AbortError'. Keep correct finally/resource ownership and no leak into later scope. Test observed data + pending background -> real manual refresh -> cancellation at0ms produces NO false10s timeout or approvals error; foreground pending/error/loading and later success must behave truthfully. Timer-triggered hangs must STILL become visible error at the bound. Optional tighten isBackground to boolean and keep separate no-arg callbacks in App; no MouseEvent coercion regressions.

L2: Header4s timer covers await res.json()/body, clear only in finally after full evaluation, preserve sequence/mount fence. Test H3 firsthealthy then headers arrive/body hangs until abort: no oldhealthyRTT survives beyond deadline, truthful failure at4s, recovery and olderbody cannot overwrite newer failure. ExistingH1/H2/error classes remain. Never bypass TLS or infer live browser acceptance.

P9 MUST click real ResourceExplorer retry and assert foreground behaviour (errorbanner cleared/loading visible while manualrequest pending), not just callcount/0text (R9). Add logout/latecompletion R6, certificate-leg hang, manual-supersede and Header-body cases above. MD removing approvals guard and ME restoring event-as-background must fail these tests. No new product path is needed to exercise the gate.
